title: ATLAS
description: A React-based application for tracking and visualising global data. Uses the Rest Countries API, the Wikipedia API, NewsAPI and the WeatherAPI to provide up-to-date information on every country in the world.

title: PLANIT
description: A Laravel + Flutter based applicaton for managing and tracking your carbon footprint. Uses Bootstrap 5 for styling, and is hosted on Laravel Cloud.

title: SAVOUR
description: A website created with Bootstrap for a fictional app called Savour, which helps users manage their food waste and discover recipes based on ingredients they have at home. This is a two-part project made for two different classes. The website is fully functional, and the attached Figma prototype is for the prototype of the App. The prototype was used as a design reference to ensure stylistic consistency between the app and the website.

title: Personal Blog
description: A personal blog platform to share articles and thoughts.
